_comment: The Blender this repository renders with. Pinned because SPEC §9.5 makes the 3D
executor a compatibility anchor, and because the integration suites assert on
measured behaviour (engine enums, Cycles smoke test, ffprobe output) rather than
`bytes` is what Blender's own directory listing publishes:
`sha256` is null until the first verified download records it. Blender publishes NO
checksum beside this release (blender-5.2.1-macos-arm64.dmg.sha256, release.sha256 and
SHA256SUMS all 404), so there is no upstream digest to pin against. It is filled in by
whatever the pinned URL currently serves. That makes the next install detect a CHANGED
artifact; it does not make the first install trustworthy, and the installer says so
rather than reporting a self-check as verification.
To upgrade Blender: change version/url/bytes here, set sha256 to null, run --record,
review the diff, then run the full acceptance suite before committing.
